mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the descending line). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the descending line on the left and the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center on the right.
